items.description: A returned user or subgroup membership.

displayName.description: Name of the group or team, if returned.

Group.description: A SCIM org group or team selected by the connection, including returned membership.

syncs.description: Make available Lucid's non-deactivated SCIM users, including identity, administrative roles, enterprise profile, and group or team associations. Lucid excludes deactivated users from this source collection.
syncs.name: sync-users

active.description: Whether the user can authenticate, if returned.

emails.description: Email entries, if returned; empty means none reported.

externalId.description: Provisioning client's external identifier, if returned.

LucidUser.description: A non-deactivated Lucid SCIM user with identity, administrative roles, enterprise profile, and group or team associations.

functions.name: add-member-to-group
functions.description: Add one user to an org group or team, or one subgroup to an org group, without replacing existing memberships.

groupId.description: Opaque destination org group or team ID.

memberId.description: Opaque user ID, or subgroup ID for org groups only.

FunctionInput_lucid_scim_addmembertogrou.description: Destination and single user or subgroup membership to add.

id.description: Modified destination group or team ID.

members.description: Membership returned after the addition; omitted is not a verified full member list.

items.description: One returned user or subgroup membership.

FunctionOutput_lucid_scim_addmembertogro.description: Modified destination resource returned by Lucid after adding the membership.

tags.instructions: Obtain groupId from `list-groups` and memberId from `list-users` or `list-groups`. The connection determines group versus team mode; teams only accept user members. Use `update-group` to replace the entire member list, and `remove-member-from-group` to remove one relationship. This adds an association, not a user or subgroup resource.

functions.name: create-group
functions.description: Create a SCIM org group or team, as selected by the connection. In team mode Lucid can restore a matching archived, closed team instead of creating a new one.

memberIds.description: Initial requested member IDs. Org groups support users or subgroups; teams support users only. Omission leaves provider behavior; [] explicitly supplies an empty list.

items.description: Opaque user or subgroup ID requested as an initial member.

displayName.description: Name to create, or matching archived closed team name to restore in team mode.

FunctionInput_lucid_scim_creategroup.description: Create an org group or create/restore a team using the connection-selected mode.

id.description: Opaque ID of the created group or created/restored team.

members.description: Membership returned after creation or restoration; not fabricated from the request.

memberId.description: Opaque member user or subgroup ID.

items.description: A member returned by Lucid after creation or restoration.

FunctionOutput_lucid_scim_creategroup.description: The identity and resource details returned by Lucid, without asserting whether a team was newly created or restored.

tags.instructions: Use this with the connection for the intended org group or team mode; there is no per-call mode selector. In team mode a matching archived, closed team may be restored, so success does not always mean a new identity. Use `update-group` for a known existing ID and `list-groups` to look up active names. Teams accept only user members; org groups also accept subgroup IDs.

functions.name: create-user
functions.description: Provision a Lucid user with email addresses and optional personal, administrative role, and enterprise profile attributes.

name.description: Initial personal name; omitted leaves provider behavior.

roles.description: Administrative roles to assign; [] supplies no administrative roles. Omission leaves provider behavior.

active.description: Whether the user can authenticate; omission uses the provider default.

type.description: Address label, such as work or home; omit to leave provider default.

primary.description: Whether this address is primary; omit to leave provider behavior.

emails.description: Initial email entries; no primary address is chosen automatically.

password.description: Optional initial password, at least eight characters; never returned.

userName.description: New user's username, usually their email.

enterprise.description: Enterprise profile attributes; omitted fields are not supplied.

managerId.description: Manager's existing opaque Lucid user ID, obtainable from list-users.

displayName.description: Displayed user name; omitted leaves provider behavior.

phoneNumbers.description: Initial work phone entries; [] explicitly supplies no entries.

type.description: Only work numbers are supported; defaults to work.

number.description: Phone number text, sent without reformatting.

FunctionInput_lucid_scim_createuser.description: Attributes for provisioning a new Lucid user.

roles.description: Administrative role names returned by Lucid.

active.description: Whether the created user can authenticate, if returned.

items.description: An email entry returned by Lucid.

FunctionOutput_lucid_scim_createuser.description: Identity and access summary from the created Lucid user, without the initial password.

tags.instructions: Use this to provision a new user, not to change an existing one; use `list-users` to check an email or external ID and `update-user` for an existing ID. Roles grant administrative access. A successful response establishes creation, not delivery of an invitation. Do not retry an uncertain creation blindly; look up the username or email first.

functions.name: delete-group-or-archive-team
functions.description: Delete an org group, or archive a team, according to the connection's token mode. An org group may need to have all members removed first.

groupId.description: Opaque ID to delete in org-group mode or archive in team mode; mode is fixed by the connection.

FunctionInput_lucid_scim_deletegrouporar.description: Target org group or team for the connection-selected lifecycle change.

id.description: Opaque target ID for the completed group deletion or team archival.

completed.description: True only after provider-confirmed completion of the connection-selected effect; does not distinguish deleted from archived.

FunctionOutput_lucid_scim_deletegroupora.description: Provider-confirmed completion of group deletion or team archival.

tags.instructions: Get the target ID from `list-groups` or `get-group` and verify that the connection is for the intended resource mode. Org-group connections delete the group; team connections archive the team instead. Use `update-group` with memberIds:[] only if you intentionally want to clear membership first. Team restoration may be possible through `create-group` using the matching archived, closed team name; org-group recovery is not documented.

functions.name: delete-user-permanently
functions.description: Hard-delete a user from the Lucid account. Account owners and default document owners may not be deleted; deactivation is the provider-recommended alternative.

userId.description: Opaque Lucid user ID to permanently delete.

FunctionInput_lucid_scim_deleteuserperma.description: The known Lucid user to permanently delete.

id.description: Opaque ID targeted by the successful deletion.

deleted.description: True only after Lucid confirms successful hard deletion.

FunctionOutput_lucid_scim_deleteuserperm.description: Acknowledgment of a provider-confirmed permanent user deletion.

tags.instructions: Prefer `update-user` with active:false when the goal is to disable authentication. Use this only for intentional hard deletion of a known user ID from `list-users`, `create-user`, or stored provisioning data. This is not recoverable deactivation. Account owners and default document owners must have ownership reassigned before deletion is possible.

functions.name: get-group
functions.description: Get one SCIM org group or team, including returned user and subgroup membership, using the connection-selected resource mode.

groupId.description: Opaque ID of an org group or team accessible to this connection.

FunctionInput_lucid_scim_getgroup.description: Identify the org group or team to retrieve through this connection.

id.description: Opaque org group or team ID.

members.description: Returned users and, for org groups, subgroups. Omitted membership is not an assertion of no members.

items.description: A returned user or subgroup membership.

displayName.description: Group or team name, if returned.

FunctionOutput_lucid_scim_getgroup.description: The requested org group or team and its returned membership details.

tags.instructions: Obtain the ID from `list-groups` or `create-group`. Use this before replacing membership or deleting an org group. Teams support only user members; org groups can also contain subgroups. The connection's token determines which resource mode is accessible.

functions.name: get-user
functions.description: Look up one non-deactivated user by Lucid ID using the user collection's equality filter. This does not provide access to deactivated users.

userId.description: Opaque Lucid user ID to look up among non-deactivated users.

FunctionInput_lucid_scim_getuser.description: Look up a non-deactivated user by an opaque Lucid user ID.

active.description: Whether this user can authenticate, if returned.

emails.description: Returned email addresses, preserving labels and primary flags.

profile.description: Remaining typed profile attributes, when returned.

FunctionOutput_lucid_scim_getuser.description: The uniquely matching visible user with identity, access and grouped profile attributes.

tags.instructions: Use a user ID from `list-users` or `create-user`. This lookup cannot distinguish a deactivated user from an absent user. Use `list-users` for browsing or email/external-ID matching. A known deactivated ID can still be passed directly to `update-user`; do not interpret this lookup's absence as proof of deletion.

functions.name: list-groups
functions.description: Return one page of SCIM groups: org groups or teams, as selected by the connection's bearer token. Optionally match an exact, case-sensitive display name.

limit.description: Maximum records requested in one page; default and local maximum are 100.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for this connection, displayName condition and limit; omit initially.

displayName.description: Optional exact case-sensitive group or team name; omit to browse without filtering. Empty string is an explicit exact-name condition.

FunctionInput_lucid_scim_listgroups.description: Select one page of connection-selected SCIM groups or teams, optionally by exact name.

id.description: Opaque Lucid org group or team ID.

members.description: Returned membership; org groups may contain users or subgroups, while teams contain users only. Omission is not an empty membership assertion.

memberId.description: Opaque user or subgroup ID from member value.

resourceUrl.description: Member resource URI from $ref, if returned.

items.description: A returned user or subgroup membership.

displayName.description: Org group or team name, if returned.

items.description: A Lucid SCIM org group or team.
Groups or teams in the provider page, in provider order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation; omitted when the collection is exhausted.

FunctionOutput_lucid_scim_listgroups.description: One provider page of SCIM groups or teams and its optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use this to find IDs before `get-group`, `update-group`, or membership changes. The connection selects whether these records are org groups or teams; this tool cannot switch modes. Continue with nextCursor as cursor using the same displayName and limit. Each page requests at most 100 groups.

schemas.description: URIs describing the schema resource itself, when returned.

items.description: A SCIM resource schema published by Lucid.

functions.name: list-users
functions.description: Return one page of users visible through SCIM, optionally matching an equality filter. Deactivated users are excluded by Lucid, including from reported totals.

limit.description: Maximum users requested in this page; defaults to 100. The local maximum is 100.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from the same connection, filter, and limit; omit for the first page.

filter.description: Optional equality condition. Omission lists users without a filter; non-optimized attributes may be slow.

value.description: Exact comparison value, serialized by the implementation into a SCIM eq expression.

attribute.description: SCIM user attribute name, such as email, username, displayname, externalid, or a fully qualified extension attribute.

FunctionInput_lucid_scim_listusers.description: Request one page of Lucid SCIM users with an optional equality condition.

name.description: Structured personal name; omitted if not returned.

roles.description: Administrative role names unwrapped from role value objects; omitted if not returned.

title.description: Job title; omitted if not returned.

active.description: Whether the user can authenticate to Lucid; omitted if not returned.

emails.description: Email addresses, preserving order and primary markers; omitted if not returned.

type.description: Address label such as work or home.

address.description: Email address from the provider value field.

primary.description: Whether this address is marked primary.

groups.description: Returned group or team associations; omitted if not returned.

displayName.description: Name of the associated group or team.

items.description: One returned group or team association.

schemas.description: SCIM schema URIs describing this user; omitted if not returned.

userName.description: Login username, usually an email address; omitted if not returned.

enterprise.description: Enterprise profile extension; omitted if not returned.

managerId.description: Opaque Lucid user ID of the manager.

externalId.description: Provisioning client's external identifier; omitted if not returned.

displayName.description: Displayed user name; omitted if not returned.

phoneNumbers.description: Phone entries, currently work numbers only; omitted if not returned.

number.description: Phone number as stored, without reformatting.

items.description: A user visible through Lucid SCIM.
Users in this provider page, excluding deactivated users.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for another page; omitted when exhausted.

totalResults.description: Provider-reported matching user count, excluding deactivated users; filtered retrieval is capped at 10,000.

FunctionOutput_lucid_scim_listusers.description: One page of users and any continuation supported by the returned pagination metadata.

tags.instructions: Use this to browse users or find their IDs before `update-user` or `delete-user-permanently`. Prefer email, username, display name, or external ID filters for fast lookups. Use `get-user` for a known user ID. Continue with nextCursor as cursor and keep the same filter and limit. Each call returns one page; filtered results are capped by Lucid at 10,000 users.

functions.name: remove-member-from-group
functions.description: Remove one user or subgroup association from a connection-selected org group or team without deleting the member resource or replacing other memberships.

groupId.description: Opaque org group or team ID containing the membership.

memberId.description: Opaque ID of the exact user or subgroup association to remove.

FunctionInput_lucid_scim_removememberfro.description: The destination group or team and the exact membership to remove.

members.description: Membership returned after removal; omitted does not assert an empty membership.

memberId.description: Opaque remaining user or subgroup ID.

items.description: A remaining user or subgroup association.

FunctionOutput_lucid_scim_removememberfr.description: The modified group or team and the membership details returned by Lucid.

tags.instructions: Use `get-group` to inspect membership and obtain the exact memberId. This removes only the association, not the user or subgroup itself. Use `update-group` with memberIds:[] to intentionally clear all membership, or `add-member-to-group` to add an association. Removing a member may revoke access granted by that membership.

functions.name: replace-group
functions.description: Replace the writable name and membership of one connection-selected org group or team while retaining its identity.

groupId.description: Opaque org group or team ID to replace.

items.description: Opaque user or subgroup member ID.

memberIds.description: Complete desired membership; [] means no members. Org groups allow user or subgroup IDs, teams only users.

displayName.description: Complete desired group or team name.

FunctionInput_lucid_scim_replacegroup.description: Complete desired writable state of one connection-selected org group or team.

id.description: Opaque ID of the replaced group or team.

memberId.description: Opaque user or subgroup member ID.

items.description: Returned user or subgroup membership association.

FunctionOutput_lucid_scim_replacegroup.description: Group or team resource returned after replacement.

tags.instructions: Use `update-group` for partial changes or the membership tools for one association. This tool requires both the desired name and complete member list; members not supplied in that list are removed. Use `get-group` first when constructing the complete desired state. Teams accept only user members.

functions.name: replace-user
functions.description: Replace the writable SCIM user profile with a supplied complete profile. Unlike a partial update, omitted optional writable attributes are intended to be cleared or reset under Lucid's replacement semantics.

userId.description: Opaque Lucid user ID whose writable profile is replaced.

name.description: Complete desired personal name; omitted components are not preserved.

roles.description: Complete desired administrative-role list; [] explicitly clears roles.

active.description: Desired authentication access; omission uses replacement default, not preservation.

primary.description: Whether the email is primary, if specified.

enterprise.description: Complete desired enterprise profile; omitted fields are not preserved.

managerId.description: Desired manager's opaque Lucid user ID.

displayName.description: Desired displayed name; omission requests replacement default or removal.

phoneNumbers.description: Complete work-phone list; [] explicitly clears it.

profile.description: Complete writable profile. Omitted optional fields are not preserved; null is not accepted. Arrays are complete desired collections.

FunctionInput_lucid_scim_replaceuser.description: User identity and complete desired writable SCIM profile.

FunctionOutput_lucid_scim_replaceuser.description: Stored user summary returned by Lucid after replacement.

tags.instructions: Use `update-user` for ordinary partial changes. Use this only when you have the user's ID and intend a complete writable-profile replacement, including email and administrative-role state. Omitted optional attributes may be removed or reset. This cannot change the user's password. Read the current user through `get-user` or `list-users` first when it is visible.

functions.name: update-group
functions.description: Partially modify a connection-selected org group or team name, or replace its membership. Omitted fields remain unchanged.

memberIds.description: Complete desired membership; [] removes all members. Omission preserves existing membership.

items.description: Opaque user or subgroup ID to include in the complete desired membership.

displayName.description: Replacement group or team name; cannot be cleared.

changes.description: Partial modifications; omitted fields are preserved and null is not accepted.

groupId.description: Opaque group or team ID to modify.

FunctionInput_lucid_scim_updategroup.description: The group or team to modify and only the fields to change.

id.description: Opaque modified group or team ID.

FunctionOutput_lucid_scim_updategroup.description: The modified group or team details returned by Lucid.

tags.instructions: Get groupId from `list-groups` or `create-group`. Use `add-member-to-group` or `remove-member-from-group` for one association without replacing other members. Supplying memberIds here replaces the full member list; [] clears it. Org groups can include subgroups, teams cannot. Use `replace-group` only for complete replacement.

functions.name: update-user
functions.description: Partially modify a user's identity, personal and enterprise profile, administrative roles, or ability to authenticate. Omitted attributes remain unchanged; active:false deactivates the user without hard deletion.

userId.description: Opaque Lucid user ID to modify, including a previously known deactivated ID.

name.description: Partial personal-name changes; omitted subfields remain unchanged.

formatted.description: Replacement formatted name; null removes it.

givenName.description: Replacement given name; null removes it.

familyName.description: Replacement family name; null removes it.

roles.description: Complete replacement administrative-role list; [] removes all administrative roles.

title.description: Replacement job title; null removes it.

active.description: False deactivates authentication; true requests authentication access. Omission leaves access unchanged.

emails.description: Complete replacement email list; cannot be cleared by this tool.

type.description: Address label, such as work; omitted label is not supplied.

primary.description: Whether this address is primary; omitted flag is not supplied.

userName.description: Replacement login username; cannot be cleared.

enterprise.description: Partial enterprise changes; omitted subfields remain unchanged.

managerId.description: Replacement manager's Lucid user ID; null removes the manager relationship.

costCenter.description: Replacement cost center; null removes it.

externalId.description: Replacement provisioning-client ID; null removes it.

displayName.description: Replacement displayed name; null removes it; empty string is an explicit empty value.

phoneNumbers.description: Complete replacement work-phone list; [] removes all entries.

type.description: Supported phone label, defaulting to work.

changes.description: Partial changes. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Nullable optional scalars use null to remove the attribute; supplied arrays replace the entire collection.

FunctionInput_lucid_scim_updateuser.description: Identify a Lucid user and supply only the profile or authentication changes to apply.

roles.description: Administrative role names returned after modification.

active.description: Authentication access flag returned after modification.

displayName.description: Displayed name, if returned after modification.

FunctionOutput_lucid_scim_updateuser.description: Identity and authentication summary from the modified Lucid user resource.

tags.instructions: Obtain a user ID from `list-users` or `create-user`; a known deactivated ID can also be used directly. Supply only changes. Setting active to false blocks authentication; use true to request access again. Role and email arrays replace their existing collections. Use `replace-user` only for a complete writable-profile replacement, and `delete-user-permanently` only for hard deletion.
